question: According to ICD-11, premature ejaculation is classified under which phase of the sexual response cycle?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Desire-phase disorders include hypoactive sexual desire dysfunction. Premature ejaculation occurs during the orgasm/ejaculation phase.
Arousal-phase disorders include erectile dysfunction (in men) and female sexual arousal dysfunction. Premature ejaculation is categorised under the orgasm/ejaculation phase.
Correct. Premature ejaculation (ICD-11 HA02) is an orgasm-phase dysfunction, characterised by ejaculation that occurs before or very shortly after vaginal penetration with minimal stimulation.
The resolution phase is not the site of classification for the common psychosexual disorders; no ICD-11 dysfunction is primarily a resolution-phase disorder.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the ICD-11 Chapter 17 phase-framework: desire → arousal/excitation → orgasm/ejaculation → resolution. Map each common disorder to its phase before moving on.
Well done. Phase-based classification underpins treatment selection — arousal-phase and orgasm-phase disorders often require different pharmacological and psychotherapeutic approaches.
